en.name: DriftDate: Layered Dating
en.title: DriftDate — Layered Dating
en.subtitle: Dating that widens slowly
en.short_description: Dating that starts in your ZIP code and widens only when you want it to.
en.description:
Most dating apps open with the whole country and let you filter down. DriftDate does the opposite: it starts where you are and widens only when you ask it to.

—— Layers ——

Discovery expands in steps — ZIP code, then county, then state, then everywhere. You choose when to move outward, so "nearby" actually means nearby, and you see your own area properly before it gets diluted.

—— Safety is part of the product ——

COARSE LOCATION, ALWAYS
Your position is deliberately blurred before it is ever used. Raw coordinates are never exposed to another user, and no one can see exactly where you are.

TRUST PASSPORT AND TRUST SCORE
See what has actually been verified about someone, rather than guessing from photos.

SAFETY CENTRE
Blocking, reporting and safety guidance in one place, not buried in settings.

BLOCK LIST
Block anyone, at any time. Blocks are immediate and permanent unless you undo them.

—— Talking to people ——

CHAT WITH REPLY SUGGESTIONS
When a conversation stalls, DriftDate can suggest a reply, with the tone matched to the thread rather than one generic template.

DATE PLANNER
Work out where to actually go, together.

AI COMPATIBILITY
A read on what you have in common, shown as reasons rather than a bare number.

—— Honest about what this is ——

DriftDate is for adults looking to meet other adults. It is 17+. Meeting someone from the internet carries real risk: tell a friend where you are going, meet in public first, and use the Safety Centre. We verify what we can and cannot vouch for anyone.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing DriftDate.

DriftDate is a 17+ dating app with layered, radius-based discovery (ZIP to county to state to everywhere). Moderation tooling is first-class: a Safety Centre, per-user blocking and reporting, and a Trust Passport. Location is coarsened by a LocationFuzzer before use, so raw coordinates are never exposed to another user. IMPORTANT: sign-in is by SMS one-time code, so reviewing this build needs a demo account provisioned with a fixed code - see the note below.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and step through onboarding.
2. Sign-in is by phone number and SMS one-time code. A reviewer cannot receive an SMS on an arbitrary number, so a demo phone number with a fixed code must be provisioned before submission; it is listed in the demo-account field of this submission.
3. After sign-in, Discover shows candidates in the innermost layer (your ZIP). Use the layer control to widen to county, state and everywhere.
4. Open any profile, then Trust Passport, to see which checks have actually been verified.
5. Open a chat and use the reply suggestion - the tone is chosen to match the thread.
6. Open the Safety Centre from the menu to see blocking, reporting and safety guidance.
7. Block a user from their profile, then open Blocked Users to confirm the block took effect.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your profile, photos, messages, and a deliberately coarsened location. Sign-in is by phone number.
• Network: Profiles, matches and messages are stored on our Supabase backend; reply suggestions are generated server-side.
• Location: Coarsened by a LocationFuzzer before it is used or stored. Raw coordinates are never exposed to another user, and no precise position is shown to anyone.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
